component.name: Open Game Launcher
component.summary: All your games in one launcher
Alle deine Spiele in einem Launcher

description.p: Open Game Launcher (OG) shows your Steam, Epic Games (via Heroic on Linux), Roblox and your own games in one fast, good-looking library. Everything runs locally – no account needed.

ul.li: Installed and not installed games, install and uninstall through the official clients
Free games on Epic and Steam with a countdown
3 layouts, 20 designs and a design editor, 9 languages
Start errors explained step by step
